description: This file defines a PersistentStoreProxy class and related functions for managing persistent storage with deep merging and proxy-based updates, primarily used for state management in a web or app environment.

classes.name: PersistentStoreProxy
classes.description: A class providing a static method to create a persistent, reactive state object backed by storage.

methods.name: PersistentStoreProxy.new
methods.description: Creates a new persistent state object with deep merging and proxy wrapping, initialized from storage or default state.
